title: Two threads, one counter
summary: Protect a shared counter with a mutex so no update is lost.
hints: `counter++` is three steps (read, add, write): two threads can read the same value and one update disappears. Wrap it in `pthread_mutex_lock(&m)` / `pthread_mutex_unlock(&m)`.
Initialise the mutex with `PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER` (or `pthread_mutex_init`). Join both threads before printing.
